# Embedded Service Reference

The release binary contains **40 services**: **7 core definitions** and **33 addons**. This inventory is generated from the embedded catalog and changes only with the binary.

Image tags below are update-discovery inputs. Official first-run locks use the release-reviewed embedded OCI snapshot; explicit updates and external sources create new platform-specific locks. Generated Compose files always use exact digests.
